issue: 'Choose...' gauge disclosure has no aria-expanded/aria-controls and no focus move.

locations: nixie skin: Departures, StatusTracker, KpiTiles, OsdStrip
issue: Contrast depends on user colours or art: secondary island text can fall below 4.5:1 with custom tint; 9px text over key art; thin nixie numerals lose weight.
fix: Cap at opacity-75 or compute from fgColor/bgColor; scrim behind text blocks; raise nixie numWeight or size floor.

issue: Wrench button is opacity-50 with title only and no aria-label/focus style; looping background video has no pause; touch notices are not a live region; kiosk root has no main landmark.
fix: aria-label='Open InfoPanel Studio', opacity-70 + focus ring; pause toggle on the dots strip or documented exception; role=status; <main aria-label={pageName}>.

surface: Kiosk dots strip and touch overlay
issue: Fixed dots strip covers content on scroll pages; overlay headings use fixed text-5xl/7xl and overflow with long names.
fix: Strip backdrop in scroll mode; max-w-[90vw] break-words text-[clamp(2rem,8vw,4.5rem)].

issue: Navigation views use aria-pressed instead of aria-current; the section chevron is aria-hidden yet focusable.
fix: aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined}; make chevron a span or keep tabIndex -1 without aria-hidden.

surface: Empty states without a next step
issue: 'Nothing on this page yet.' and 'Nothing here yet.' state the fact and do not point forward.
fix: 'Nothing on this page yet. Use the Add tab to place a widget.' (button to tab=add); 'No screens yet. Use New to start one.'

issue: Delete sits beside Hide in neutral text-ui-5 and turns red only on hover; Discard looks identical to Cancel with no focus on the safe option.
fix: Delete last behind a divider with text-ui-danger/80 and 'Delete group'; danger outline for Discard and focus Cancel.
evidence: Verified in audit; undo exists so not a trigger.

issue: Window-level Escape toggles 'Skip setup?' even from the address field; Convert opens its dialog after a 300ms setTimeout, which may fire before the screen is ready.
fix: Mirror the Enter guard (skip for inputs/defaultPrevented); open from an effect once the screen is active.

issue: Rows that need a bigger zone get opacity-40 on the whole row, pushing name and reason text under 3:1.
fix: Dim icon and footprint only.

issue: 'testing...' (three dots) vs ellipsis character elsewhere; straight vs curly quotes in 'Nothing matches'.
fix: Use the ellipsis character and curly quotes.

issue: Maximize and Restore both use the Square icon.
fix: Two-square icon when maximized.

surface: Settings button names and copy feedback
issue: 'Show all (12)' has no aria-expanded and no collapse; three buttons all named 'Show'; 'Copied' appears only in the button label.
fix: aria-expanded and 'Show all {section} changes ({n})' with toggle; aria-label='Show {label}'; also toast('Copied') via the status region.

issue: An unknown article link opens Help home with no message.
fix: A line at the top of Home: 'That article isn't here. Browse the topics.'

issue: The sticky top-5 release rail does not scroll itself; 10 entries are about 440px, taller than a 520px window.
fix: max-h-[calc(100vh-40px)] overflow-auto on the rail.

issue: Axis labels (60 fps / 16.7 ms, 0 ms . last 1 min) about 9px grey.
fix: 10-11px, --w-muted.

locations: DayPlanner, Calendar, DriveSpace, StatusTracker (title changes with size)
issue: Titles name the wrong stat or change with size; 'LIVE / 0 min' looks like a bug; '4/5 OK now' does not name the failing item; Bluetooth repeats 'Connected' on every row.
fix: Titles 'Frame histogram'/'Frame time'; keep the kind's name as title with dynamic value as subtitle; 'Live for 0 min' or hide until 1 min; name the failing item at 2x2; show only non-default states.

issue: 4x4 shot is blank apart from title and '-8.7 dB' (2x2 shows bars): no empty/no-signal state if the canvas is empty.
fix: Quiet baseline or Empty; check QA capture delay.
evidence: Inferred; may be a capture-timing gap.

surface: Skins: duplicate titles and tiny pixel fonts
locations: tui and retro: CoreHeatmap, Timer, OsdStrip, StatusTracker, FpsMonitor, Weather 2x2
issue: In tui the inner header repeats the frame title; in retro Timer presets and Music/Game labels fall to about 7px.
fix: Hide the inner title when the skin frames one; floor font size in retro.

issue: Unused file and tokens carrying failing pairs (colour-only on/off dot 1.19:1 apart; focus ring 2.11:1).
fix: Delete the file and the unused tokens.

issue: 6px thumb #2e2e35 on #0c0c0e is 1.45:1 with arrows removed; long lists show no idle scroll cue.
fix: Thumb about #4a4a54 and 8px wide, or fade masks.

issue: Numbered text tones next to role names; choosing by number is how failing text-ui-5 reached body copy.
fix: When the contrast fix lands rename 5 to hint/disabled, keep 1-4.
